verdict.rationale: Snyk documents concrete fix advice and automated fix PR workflows for open-source dependencies (snyk-docs-21), plus newer agentic/CLI remediation tools (snyk fix --agentic, Remediation Agent) that generate and apply fix plans. However, community hands-on feedback specifically about the automated PR tool describes it as low-quality (missing entire version upgrades, creating excessive/noisy PRs, forcing users to disable it) compared to alternatives like Dependabot, which contradicts the 'concrete upgrade path' quality claim. missing for 10: independent validation that the agentic remediation/fix PR quality has improved, resolution of the documented PR-quality complaints, and evidence of upgrade-path accuracy beyond vendor docs.
